title: Finite Galois neighbourhood representative of any geometric germ
statement: Let $K\subset K_s\subset\Omega$ be a compatible tower of fields [def-pc-field-extension], where $K_s$ is a separable closure of $K$ [def-kun-separably-closed] and $\Omega$ is algebraically closed and algebraic over $K$. Let $s=\operatorname{Spec}(K\to\Omega)$ be the canonical geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point] and $F$ a sheaf of sets on the small etale site of $\operatorname{Spec}K$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Write $M$ for its geometric stalk at $s$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. For every finite intermediate field $L/K$ of $K_s/K$ and every $m\in M$, there exist a finite Galois intermediate field $E/K$ of $K_s/K$ containing $L$, its canonical lift $y:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to\operatorname{Spec}E$ induced by the field inclusions, and $z\in F(\operatorname{Spec}E)$ whose germ at $y$ is $m$.

source.place: Tag 04JM (lemma-global-sections-point), direct proof; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/04JM

proof.text: Represent the germ m by (X,x,z) using Point.toPresheafFiber_jointly_surjective. Factor x through the spectrum of the residue field at its image t with SpecToEquivOfField and descResidueField_stalkClosedPointTo_fromSpecResidueField. The source theorem Scheme.Hom.etale_residueFieldMap makes the extension over the residue field of Spec K finite separable. The canonical residue-field spectrum of the unique point of Spec K is isomorphic to Spec K: it is a surjective closed immersion into a reduced scheme. Thus the composite Spec κ(t) → X → Spec K is etale and κ(t)/K is finite separable. Spec full faithfulness and the triangle x over s show that the embedding κ(t) → Ω is K-linear.

Factor the embedding of κ(t) into Ω through Ks. The extension Ω/Ks is algebraic and Ks is separably closed. Elementwise, each finite extension Ks(a) inside Ω is purely inseparable, so an element a separable over Ks belongs to Ks. Apply this to the image of each element of κ(t), which is separable over K and hence over Ks. Lean uses the general Mathlib instance Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isPurelyInseparable_of_isSepClosed and IsPurelyInseparable.inseparable, followed by IsSeparable.tower_top. Choose the preimages; injectivity of Ks → Ω proves they preserve zero, one, sums, products and K-scalars. The image field P of this embedding is finite over K by its algebra equivalence with κ(t). This gives a pointed etale-site morphism Spec P → X.

Form the finite compositum P ⊔ L in Ks and its normal closure E over K inside Ks. Mathlib IntermediateField.finiteDimensional_sup, normalClosure.is_finiteDimensional, IsGalois.normalClosure and IntermediateField.le_normalClosure construct a finite Galois intermediate field containing both P and L. This is the normal-closure construction underlying the finite-set-in-finite-Galois-subextension node (Stacks 09DT and 0EXM), applied to generators of the finite compositum, without explicitly choosing bases.

Let y be the canonical lift induced by E → Ks → Ω and pull z back along Spec E → Spec P → X. Spec.map_comp and composition of the inclusions show that the induced lift on X equals x. Apply Point.toPresheafFiber_w_apply to the pullback section, then rewrite by this equality of lifts. Its germ is m, giving the conclusion with the original statement unchanged.

proof_origin.place: Tag 04JM direct proof, finite separable then finite Galois neighbourhood steps; 02G8(1) residue-field shortcut; 09DT and 0EXM normal closure. Fully checked Lean proof by Q1, 2026-10-13.

theorem exists_finiteGalois_germ_representative
    (K Ks Ω : Type u) [Field K] [Field Ks] [Field Ω]
    [Algebra K Ks] [IsSepClosure K Ks] [Algebra Ks Ω] [Algebra K Ω]
    [IsScalarTower K Ks Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic K Ω]
    (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec (.of K))
    (hs : s = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω)))
    (F : Sheaf (Spec (.of K)).smallEtaleTopology (Type (max (u + 1) v)))
    (L : IntermediateField K Ks) [FiniteDimensional K L]
    (m : (pointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber.obj F) :
    ∃ E : FiniteGaloisIntermediateField K Ks,
      L ≤ E.toIntermediateField ∧
      ∃ y : (pointSmallEtale s).fiber.obj (etaleSpec K E),
        y.left = Spec.map
          (CommRingCat.ofHom ((algebraMap Ks Ω).comp E.toIntermediateField.subtype)) ∧
        ∃ z : F.obj.obj (op (etaleSpec K E)),
          (pointSmallEtale s).toPresheafFiber (etaleSpec K E) y F.obj z = m
